comparisons.peer_topic: Investment Banking Revenue Growth and Drivers
comparisons.peer_summary: Investment banking net revenues increased 35% to $6,170 million in 2024, driven by higher M&A advisory volumes, increased equity underwriting from IPOs and follow-ons, and higher fixed income underwriting from bond and loan issuances.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies identify investment-related revenue streams as key drivers of growth. Citigroup highlights a 15% rise in non-interest revenue specifically from higher investment fees due to growth in client investment assets. In contrast, Morgan Stanley's revenue growth in its Investment Banking segment (a component of its broader revenue mix) was driven by M&A advisory volumes and underwriting activities (equity and fixed income), rather than asset management fees alone, illustrating a difference in the specific nature of the investment-related revenue driver.

sentences.text: Revenues increased 7%, largely driven by an increase in non-interest revenue (up 15%), reflecting higher investment fee revenues on growth in client investment assets, as well as an increase in net interest income (up 2%).
